about: Dated 2026-11-04 CAD visual configuration for the battery robot, checked against CURRENT-STATE.json and user-supplied powered standing/bend scans. Component appearance is updated, not scan-registered; joint kinematics and inertias are separate. Legacy fitted.json remains unchanged.

body_override_reasons.head_components: The head shell, camera, microphones, touch board and audio ride with the head; jaw_frame remains separately labelled as jaw piece.
body_override_reasons.backpack_components: Battery enclosure, power components and A7Z saddle are torso mounted.

part_files_reason: Pinned copies in visual-20261104/source-parts preserve fitted ankles and V1.40 frame/V1.41 cap+hatch. Battery geometry is the pre-Dual-Lock screw-mount nominal frame: build-v2 sources directly; other guide battery parts translated +8.7 mm to undo the unconfirmed Dual Lock offset. This is a declared modelling assumption, not a scan-fitted mounting measurement.

jaw.open_positive: a positive angle about axis swings the lip tip down (opens)
jaw.source: guide/extension-20261012-neck-audio/neck-route/nr_lib.py JAW_PIVOT / JAW_AXIS (robot frame, mm), the hinge the jaw pose-cap study sweeps

battery.about: Same dated battery visual snapshot; explicit key for the existing variant loader.

Right ankle sleeve (V1.22, black), the inner ankle half runs on it

extra_parts_reason: The two fitted ankle sleeves are absent from the guide parts list.
not_fitted_reason: Saddle lid remains not fitted; right-angle pigtail/splice was not bought or failed. Actual factory camera lead and straight adapter lack a calibrated routed mesh. Dual Lock plate/strip installation is not confirmed by current-state. Charger hardware is removed for this battery-only visual snapshot.

evidence.current_state: microduck-sim/CURRENT-STATE.json: battery_backpack_design, parts_a7z_extensions, a7z_audio_capture, a7z_touch_bus, backpack_swap_plugs
evidence.user_scan_postures: Both scans powered: closed-loop standing (105634) and commanded bend (105915), user confirmed 2026-11-04.
evidence.head_shells: Guide V1.33 ear cap/U20 face and V1.36 floor speaker shell correspond to fitted microphones/U20/touch and scan appearance; no scan-precise dimensional acceptance claimed.
evidence.hatch: V1.41 retained by 3M foam tape after failed printed latch. Tape thickness/shape not measured and not modelled.
evidence.excluded_unmeasured: Loose cable coil, actual USB adapter stack, tape, fasteners not separately added to visual mesh; no claim of exact shape or mass.

registration.battery_mount: pre-Dual-Lock source pose; source-to-guide shift -8.7 mm not adopted without fitted confirmation
registration.scan_validation: Appearance/configuration comparison only; no numerical fit or static-stance model acceptance.
